name: inkdynamics
description: Physical ink for HTML5 canvas: four calibrated instruments (Zig Chinese brush, Posca mop squeezer, curved and flat ruling pens), slightly transparent ink that mixes where strokes cross, gravity drips, multi-agent pens and user presets. Developed as part of the SiX Research Project (FBAUP / i2ADS).

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let p=decodeURI(req.url.split('?')[0]);if(p==='/')p='/index.html';const f=path.join(process.cwd(),p);if(!fs.existsSync(f)){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not Found');}const ext=path.extname(f);const m={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg'}[ext]||'application/octet-stream';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);}).listen(8085,()=>console.log('InkDynamics running at http://localhost:8085'));"
scripts.test: node test_v3.js && node test_ruling_pens.js && node test_v4.js

author: Pedro Amado <pamado@fba.up.pt> (FBAUP / i2ADS)
